[b]War? War it is[/b]

[i]It was a dark eiry and rainy night. Nothing could be seen. Deep in the mountains though something was brewing. A group of people camping in the mountains were awoken by the sound of footsteps and yelling. The shouts of someone saying "Hoi! Elkenien no mei ID's" (Hey! Everyone out ID's now). As the people get out of the tents it was soldiers ordering them around. They were ordered to leave where they were camping immideatly. Till it was discovered that one of the camper's brothers was in the Republican Front which is the largest of the anti monachist millitas. When the soldiers found out shots rang out. The sounds of cries for help vanished into the dark black night.[/i]

[i]As the news of the massecre on the moutains was heard about anger with the government grew however it wasnt just anger it was time that the people took matters into their own hands. When the leader of the Republican Front Wiber Heeringa was informed of the massecre he shouted loudly.[/i]

[b]De Lieder Wiber Heeringa:[/b][i]"I am done sitting back hearing of this while doing nothing. King Klaes II has blood on his hands. We are done! The fight for a Republic has begun my friends. We shall fight on the beaches, we shall fight in the streets, we shall fight on the landing grouds, we shall fight on the mountain tops; we shall never surrender."[/i]

[i]It was clear the people were done with the King and his goons terrorizing the nation. Paramillitaries began to arm up and get ready for combat. On April 12 a loud boom was heard in the city of Nijstêd, then gunshots rang out. The Republican Front (RF) had launched an offensive to cut off the rails used to supply the Keninklik Ferdigeningskorps. The streets became a warzone. With explosions, constant gunshots and fire. Also foul smells which seemed odd were taking a toll. While Nijstêd was suffeing from combat, the coastal beaches were also burning. The Popular Front for the Liberation of Nevonia (PFLN) raided the beaches while the Keninklik Leger was conducting exercises. The Popular Front and Keninklik Leger enaged in close combat. PFLN Millitants while the battle on the beach snuck onto the Port of Tremond. The Port of Tremond was once where a lot of imports used to come in but since the unrest and civil war began the port was put under direct control of the Keninklike Marinewacht. Suddenly a loud explosion was heard and the Port of Tremon burst into flames then 3 more explosions followed completely engulfing the port into flames. It was once unrest but soon it was to the point of something more.[/i]

[i]Back in the capital of Tarenbur where the city was put under complete lockdown there was panic within the Alsfaed Palace the residence and office of the King. King Klaes II fired Prime Minister Eauwe Buma for not following orders and the King would appoint Keninklike Loftmacht Algemien Joris Dijkstra as the new Prime Minister.  Prime Minister Dijkstra at the King's order declared martial law across the country. As well King Klaes II made an adress that was broadcasted everywhere.[/i]

[b]King Klaes II[/b][i]"My fellow Nevonians, I know this is a tought time in our nation. We are at War now. We are not at war with the people but with the rebel terrorist. We must keep order and the terrorist who claim to speak for our nation are wrong; we will destroy the terrorist rebels. Flousechia is supplying the rebels so do not listen to them."[/i]

[i]Following the declaration of war and the King's adress the attacks by the Keninklik Ferdigeningskorps increased. In the mountains Keninklik Leger marched up and down going after people and tribe but the Rebels engaged in gurrila warfare. In the eastern areas where there is a large population of ethnic Flousechians did not see much action however that all changed when in the city of Mandiaugsville a toxic gas began to harm the people. Following the attacks in the Floueschian People's State a group of Flouechians who were fed up with the state sponsored terrorist organized and formed the Nevonesch-Floueschian Verteidegungsgarde (NFV) to protect areas with large populations of Floueschians. The NFV began to engage in skirmishes against the Royal forces.[/i]

[i]As rebels and the government fought on the battlefields, the Government stepped up the attacks against civilians. In a mine in the mountains a unit of soldiers gassed miners then entered the cave and executed the miners. The Keninklike Loftmacht started to airstrikes  the mountains. Civilians would organize local millitas to protect their fellow citizens. With the increase and escalations of attacks against civilians the unpopularity of the King and government grew. It was obvious that very few supported the King, the Keninklik Ferdigeningskorps saw mass defections of soldiers. However even with the  shrinking number of soldiers the Keninklik Ferdigeningskorps still held the upperhand for a varity of reasons. The reasons for the upperhand was that the Keninklik Ferdigeningskorps had better weapons, more weapons and one of the biggest advantages was the fighting between different rebel groups.[/i]

[i]The fighting between rebels was only an advantage for the Keninklik Ferdigeningskorps. In the coastal plains the RF and PFLN engaged in battle when the RF was spotted by the PFLN and the PFLN shot at the RF. The battle on the northern coastal plains was just an example of how fighting between rebels was taking a toll on the anti-monarchist effort. As a result of the fighting between rebels some called for cooperation for the joint effort to defeat the government. Die Leder of the RF Wiber Heeringa and General Secretary of the Simen Kramer met and negotiations for cooperation kicked off. After the meeting a much larger meeting took place between many of the large paramillitaries. The meetign was attended by: Die Leder of the RF Wiber Heeringa, General Secretary of the Simen Kramer, Commander of the National Homeland Movement Tide Ykema, General Commander of the Women's Republican Defense Unit Autgertsje van der Laan, Commander of the Nevonesch-Floueschian Verteidegungsgarde Roger Engels and others took place. The leaders of the verious militas signed an agreement known as the Frankton Agreement which formed the Nevonian National Republican Alliance. Under the Frankton Agreement paramilliltaries would halt all fighting between each other, share intellegence and fight along each other.[/i]

[i]Following the founding of the Nevonian National Republican Alliance, the alliance and the Keninklik Ferdigeningskorps engaged in battles across the country. The alliance did not imidieatly fund success as they still were underequiped and poorly trained compared to the Keninklik Ferdigeningskorps. Still there was tense battles and as well some of the paramilitaries occupying territory. The RF was very present in the western and coastal areas, the PFLN held a lot of urban areas including around 70% of Maaiefjild while the National Homeland Movement having a large presence in the southern mountian areas. The entire nation was suffering from war with no one safe it seemed. The toll on civilians were catostrophic with shelling 24/7 and maybe worst of all was the Government's use of chemical warfare. Dr Iepkje Mellema a scientist from the Maaiefjild Scientific Institute claimed that the gas used by the Government on civilians was mustard gas. Following the concusion by Dr Mellema the Maaiefijild Scientific Institute was bombed by the Keninklike Loftmacht.[/i]

[i]Everyday the Nevonian Civil War escalated more and more, with thousands of civilians being killed everyday. Much of the country was dammaged with children killed and in some of the mountians a famine was at risk of occuring. The destruction from the battles was bad but it would only get worse.[/i]
